# vastdata_de_span_logs (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch ordered log records belonging to a specific trace (and optionally a specific span).
# `functions` on `vastdata_de_trace_tree` is a set, so convert with `tolist(...)` to index a span.
data "vastdata_de_traces" "recent" {
  tenant_name   = "de-lab"
  pipeline_name = "my-pipeline"
  limit         = 1
  order_by      = "desc"
}

data "vastdata_de_trace_tree" "tree" {
  tenant_name = "de-lab"
  trace_id    = data.vastdata_de_traces.recent.data[0].trace_id
}

data "vastdata_de_span_logs" "example" {
  tenant_name = "de-lab"
  trace_id    = data.vastdata_de_traces.recent.data[0].trace_id
  span_id     = tolist(data.vastdata_de_trace_tree.tree.functions)[0].value.span_id
}

output "span_logs" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_span_logs.example.data
}

output "span_logs_pagination" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_span_logs.example.pagination
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `trace_id` (String) ID of the Trace assoicated with the telemetries

### Optional

- `span_id` (String) ID of the Span assoicated with the telemetries
- `tenant_name` (String) Tenant name for Data Engine API queries. Required for cluster-admin auth; optional when the provider already authenticates as that tenant.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `pagination` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pagination))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `guid` (String) Unique identifier of the logs
- `message` (String) Content of the Log Record
- `observed_timestamp` (Number) Time since epoch in micro sec for when the Log record was observed by Vast Telemetries Service
- `resource` (Attributes) Resource producing the telemetry, as in OTEL specification (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--resource))
- `scope` (String)
- `severity` (String) Log severity matching OTEL specification
- `span_id` (String) ID of the Span this Log is associated with
- `timestamp` (Number) Time in epoch in micro sec for when the Log record was produced
- `trace_id` (String) ID of the Trace this Log is associated with

Read-Only:

- `function_deployment_name` (String) Name of the Function Deployment as in Pipeline manifest

- `function_revision_id` (String) ID of the Function Revision

- `pipeline_revision_id` (String) ID of the Pipeline Revision
- `pipeline_version` (String) Version of the Pipeline
- `pipeline_vrn` (String) VRN of the Pipeline
- `runtime_version` (String) Serverless runtime invoking user code
- `sdk_version` (String) Serverless SDK installed in the user code
- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the tenant
